pairs.evidence: src/app/api/gate/[owner]/[repo]/route.ts:7 The gate runs a deterministic policy check over a scan. Its LLM path hands off to the scan pipeline, which lives outside this context, and the PR-comment builder only escapes and renders report text. Nothing here builds a model prompt. A search of src/lib/scoring, src/lib/github, src/lib/db, the gate routes and src/features/standing/governance for systemPrompt, buildPrompt, maxTokens, cache_control and tokenBudget found nothing.
